title: Feature request: Alert on stale loop/pump data in NightScout
symptom: The user requests a feature to alert when Loop hasn't successfully talked to the pump in X minutes. In their situation, the USB cable charging the RileyLink died, causing the RileyLink to run out of power in the middle of the night. NightScout raises an alert condition when this happens, and they want xDrip to pick up this alert from NightScout.
evidence_quote: I'm requesting a feature to alert when Loop hasn't successfully talked to the pump in X minutes. In our situation, the USB cable (yes of all things, the actual cable) charging her RileyLink died. The RileyLink eventually ran out of power in the middle of the night. NightScout raises an alert condition when this happens. If xDrip could pick up this alert from NightScout, that would be very helpful.
